name: The Westin Hamburg
positioning: The Westin Hamburg Elbphilharmonie: a hotel inside Hamburg's Elbphilharmonie concert hall building in HafenCity, with glass-walled rooms over the port and a spa with an indoor pool
best_for: Concertgoers who want to stay in the Elbphilharmonie itself
Travelers wanting harbor and Elbe views
Families wanting a city hotel with pool time and kids' touches

facts.text: The Elbphilharmonie building was designed by Swiss architects Herzog & de Meuron.
The Elbphilharmonie is built on a historic warehouse and crowned by glass.
The puristic interior design is inspired by water, sand and wind.
From select rooms guests can watch the Queen Mary II enter port.
The spa has Finnish and bio saunas and steam baths.
Hotel guests have complimentary access to the day spa.
Fang & Feld serves North Sea fish and fruit and vegetables from the Alte Land near Hamburg.
BLICK Bar on the 8th floor serves crafted cocktails and small bites.
A tipi is available for kids under six.
Families get exclusive pool times with water toys.

highlights.text: The hotel is located directly in the Elbphilharmonie.
Guests reach the concert hall through a revolving door on the hotel's 8th floor.
Premium Waterfront rooms look out on small boats and large cruise ships passing on the Elbe.
The Heavenly Spa has an indoor pool with natural daylight above Hamburg's port.
A Private Spa Suite offers a private whirlpool, sauna and steam bath.

considerations.text: Classic rooms do not have a view of Hamburg or the harbor because they are inside the Elbphilharmonie; choose a higher category for views.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack traditional Hamburg charm.
